C05_S03: CHECKED NEWTON/BETA MIXTURE AND EXPLOSIVE-BIRTH INTERPRETATION
7 October UTC / 8 October Brisbane, 2026. INITIAL unchanged.
Status: exact finite/infinite probabilistic identities and an explicit Chernoff
bound reconstructed below. The original positive-Beta Newton route was proposed
by this worker before receiving the contour proof. Root subsequently supplied
the explosive-birth interpretation and Chernoff-rate lead; those parts are
attributed to root and independently checked here. No larger SEP radius follows
from this lemma. The last route limitation is explicitly scoped to the generic
Legendre/white-margin bound, not every possible completion method.

1. EXACT FINITE IDENTITY
Fix N>=1,0<=k<=N, x=(k-N/2)^2 and A_r=(N/2+r)^2,r>=1. Let a>0, f(x)=e^-ax,
and P_(m-1)(x) be its degree<=m-1 Newton interpolation polynomial at A1..Am.
Its Newton basis is product_(r=1)^l(A_r-x) with coefficients
 (-1)^l f[A1,...,A_(l+1)]>0.
Positivity follows from the divided-difference mean-value theorem because
f^(l)=(-a)^l e^-a x. The basis values factor as
 A_r-x=(r+k)(r+N-k)=:lambda_r>0.

Let independent E_r have exponential rates lambda_r and put T_m=sum_(r=1)^m E_r.
Then EXACTLY
 P_(m-1)(x)=e^-ax P(T_m>a).                                (N1)
To check it, use the Lagrange interpolation formula and A_r-x=lambda_r:
 P_(m-1)(x)=e^-ax sum_(i=1)^m e^-a lambda_i
                    product_(j!=i)lambda_j/(lambda_j-lambda_i).
The rates are distinct and increasing. The displayed sum is the standard
hypoexponential survival expression, verified directly by the Laplace
transform(1/s)[1-product_r lambda_r/(s+lambda_r)] and its simple-pole partial
fractions. This is a complete derivation, not reliance on a numerical table.

Each positive Newton term yields a positive beta coherent mixture. In fact
 product_(r=1)^l(A_r-x)=(k+1)_l(N-k+1)_l,
and
 integral B_N,k(p)[p(1-p)]^l dp
 =[(k+1)_l(N-k+1)_l]/[(N+1)(N+2)_(2l)].
Thus the basis population is represented by the nonnegative density
(N+1)(N+2)_(2l)[p(1-p)]^l, proportional to beta(l+1,l+1). This confirms the
positive-Beta interpretation and all index/normalizer conventions.

2. WHY THE INFINITE POSITIVE SERIES DOES NOT REACH THE TARGET
Since sum_r1/lambda_r<infinity, T_infinity=sum_r E_r is finite almost surely
(its expectation is finite). For EVERY a>0,
 0<P(T_infinity<=a)<1.
For the lower bound choose m with expected tail<a/4. Mar
